pages.text: There is one God. God is three Persons: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. We call this the Trinity.
God the Father made us and loves us. God the Son is Jesus, who came to be with us. God the Holy Spirit helps us to love and to pray.
We make the Sign of the Cross to show we belong to God. In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: When you make the Sign of the Cross, you remember that God is always with you.

pages.text: Jesus is God's Son. He came to us as a baby at Christmas. The Church celebrates His birth every year.
Jesus grew up. He taught us to love God and to love each other. He helped the sick and was kind to everyone.
At Easter, we celebrate that Jesus rose from the dead. Jesus is alive, and He is with us always.
All year long, the Church remembers the life and teachings of Jesus. Advent and Christmas, Lent and Easter help us follow Him.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: The Church celebrates Jesus all year long. What is your favorite way to celebrate Jesus?

pages.text: Mary is the mother of Jesus. God chose Mary to be the mother of His Son. Mary said yes to God.
Mary loved Jesus and took care of Him. Mary is our mother in heaven too, and she prays for us.
We pray the Hail Mary to ask Mary to pray for us. You can find it in the Prayer mode.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Mary said yes to God. How can you say yes to God today?

pages.text: On Sunday, God's family comes together at Mass. We sing, we pray, and we listen to God's Word.
At Mass, the priest does what Jesus did at the Last Supper. The bread and wine become the Body and Blood of Jesus.
At Mass, we celebrate that Jesus is with us. Then we go home and share His love with other people.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus is with us at Mass. How can you be ready to meet Jesus at Mass?

pages.text: Someone asked Jesus, "What is the greatest commandment?" Jesus said, "Love God with all your heart."
Jesus said the second is just like it: "Love your neighbor as you love yourself."
We love others the way Jesus did. We share, we help, we forgive, and we are kind.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Who can you be kind to today? How can you treat them the way Jesus would?
